title: Edge Devices Get Smaller Language Models Built In
summary: On-device inference brings assistants to phones and sensors.

body.text: Further details are expected at a briefing scheduled for later this month.
Long term, the impact will depend on adoption by the wider industry.
If it is not measured, it will not improve.
The team behind the effort credits a small group of volunteers who worked through the summer.
The announcement follows months of speculation and comes as competition in the sector intensifies.

author.name: Tom Okafor
author.bio: Developer tools and open source reporter.
